description: Trafiksignaler is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Linköpings kommun. Measurement of traffic at traffic signals. Measurements are the number of vehicles that have passed a road at an intersection with traffic signals. The values are displayed aggregated per 15 minutes. Coverage: Linköpings kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic signals" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Linköpings kommun. Its keywords include Trafiksignaler, Trafikmätning. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
